pairs.english: Two days before the assessment, Instructor Vey set aside a preparation class for those enrolled. When Tavi arrived, an extra stool stood by the table, with Mira sitting on it.
pairs.hanzi: 考核前两天，维老师给报了名的人留出一堂准备课。塔维到时，桌边多放了一张凳子，坐着米拉。

pairs.target: tā búshì lái tì tā bàoshù de .

pairs.hanzi: 她不是来替他报数的。

pairs.target: jīntiān shì de shì zhuāngpèi zhuōshàng nà fù xiǎo jiājù , jiè xìng de rén fàngkāishǒu hòu , lìng yígè rén yào chèn duǎnzàn bǎoliú xiàlái de biànhuà , bǎ xiāozǐ sòng jìn kǒng lǐ , zài yóu qián yígè rén chóngxīn jiēchù , qǔxiāo .

pairs.hanzi: 今天试的是装配桌上那副小夹具，借性的人放开手后，另一个人要趁短暂保留下来的变化，把销子送进孔里，再由前一个人重新接触、取消。

pairs.target: zuò de réng shì cóngqián nà jiàn xiǎo huó , kě zhècì bùnéng bǎ liǎnggè rén dàngchéng yì shuāngshǒu lái yòng .
pairs.english: It was still the same small task as before, but this time two people could not be treated as a single pair of hands.
pairs.hanzi: 做的仍是从前那件小活，可这次不能把两个人当成一双手来用。

pairs.english: Mira would insert the pin. She first tried the unloaded fixture, found reaching from the left would catch Tavi’s cuff, and moved the little pin dish to the right.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉负责送销。她先拿着没有上载的夹具试了一遍，发现从左边伸手会碰到塔维的袖口，便把装销的小碟挪到右边。

pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked both iron samples’ whole volumes, the contact-patch grooves and stops, then hung the light loads before letting them take their positions.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师核过两片铁的完整体积、接触面的刻槽和止挡，将轻载挂好，才让他们站定。

pairs.english: “When do you say ‘ready’?” Mira asked. “When I am stable.” “You are stable, or it is my turn?”
pairs.hanzi:
“你什么时候说好了？”米拉问。
“我稳了就说。”
“你稳了，还是轮到我了？”

pairs.english: Tavi opened his mouth. The last time, the teacher had watched every step, and he had not felt there was any difference between those two meanings.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维张了张嘴。上回做这东西，老师看着每一步，他没觉得这两个意思有什么不同。

pairs.english: Now Mira’s hand was already by the dish, ready to move on hearing ‘ready’; he realized he needed a different phrase.
pairs.hanzi: 现在米拉的手已经放在碟边，一听见好了便会动，他才明白自己得另找个说法。

pairs.english: They agreed: ‘stable’ was only information; ‘insert’ was her cue to reach. If she lost her grip, she must say ‘stop’ directly, without making him guess.
pairs.hanzi: 他们约好，自己说稳住，只是让她知道；说送销，她才伸手。她若没拿住，要直接说停，不能让他猜。

pairs.english: Before the first attempt began, he raised both hands above the wooden bases. Instructor Vey told him to wait: after trying her reach, Mira had moved the empty dish closer, blocking where she would withdraw her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次还没开始，他就将两只手抬到木座上方。维老师叫他先等，米拉刚才试手后把空碟挪近，碟沿挡着她收手的地方。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kànjiàn , zé le yìshēng , yòu nuókāi yìdiǎn . tǎ wéi hūrán xiǎngqǐ tā zài dōng yuàn bǎi mùkuàng shí nà yìdiǎn juèjìn , kě zhèhuìer tā zhǐshì shuō , xìngkuī hái méi dòng .
pairs.english: She looked down, clicked her tongue and moved it aside. Tavi suddenly remembered her stubbornness over the east-courtyard frame, but this time she only said it was lucky they had not started.
pairs.hanzi:
她低头看见，啧了一声，又挪开一点。
塔维忽然想起她在东院摆木框时那一点倔劲，可这会儿她只是说，幸亏还没动。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān chóngxīn xièzài , fù zǎi , dú huí yuánlái de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Both sides were unloaded and reloaded again, their readings returning to the starting positions.
pairs.hanzi: 两边重新卸载、复载，读回原来的位置。

pairs.target: tā tiē shàng jiēchùmiàn , jiāng jiāohuàn mànmàn wěnzhù , tīngjiàn dúshù xiānghé , cái bào wěnzhù . mǐlā méiyǒu dòng .
pairs.english: He touched the contact patches, slowly stabilized the exchange, and only reported ‘stable’ after hearing the readings agree. Mira did not move.
pairs.hanzi: 他贴上接触面，将交换慢慢稳住，听见读数相合，才报稳住。米拉没有动。

pairs.target: tā shuō sòng xiāo , tóngshí tái kāi shuāngshǒu , xuán zài liǎngcè , děng zhe huíqù .
pairs.english: He said ‘insert’ and lifted both hands simultaneously, hovering on either side, ready to return.
pairs.hanzi: 他说送销，同时抬开双手，悬在两侧，等着回去。

pairs.target: xiāozǐ pèngdào kǒng biān , qīngqīng yìxiǎng . mǐlā méiyǒu wǎng lǐ yìng àn , lìkè shuō tíng . tā shuāngshǒu chóngxīn tiē huí , qǔxiāo , zhǐ dǎng méi shòu zhuàng , jiājù yě méiyǒu kǎzhù .
pairs.english: The pin clicked lightly against the hole’s edge. Mira did not force it in but said ‘stop’ at once. He recontacted with both hands and cancelled; the stops were not struck, and the fixture did not jam.
pairs.hanzi: 销子碰到孔边，轻轻一响。米拉没有往里硬按，立刻说停。他双手重新贴回，取消，止挡没受撞，夹具也没有卡住。

pairs.target: wūlǐ lìng yìzhāng zhuōzi shàng de bǎizhōng hái zài xiǎng .

pairs.hanzi: 屋里另一张桌子上的摆钟还在响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi juéde zìjǐ táishǒu cái yíshùn , mǐlā quèshuō gāngcái nàge kǒng zhèngduìzhe dēng , liàng dé kànbújiàn lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi felt he had lifted his hands for only an instant, but Mira said the hole had faced the lamp, too bright to see inside.

她把凳子转了半面，请老师看这样会不会碰到另一边木座。
老师看过，让她再空手走一次。

pairs.english: Standing beside them, Tavi suddenly wanted to laugh. He had prepared readings, contact and release, yet when it was somebody else’s turn there was even a lamp waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在旁边，突然有点想笑。自己准备了读数、接触、抬手，轮到别人时，竟还有一盏灯等着。

pairs.english: After resting they made only one more attempt. Mira changed her angle, and this time the pin dropped into the hole before the first pendulum click.
pairs.hanzi: 休息后，他们只再做了一回。米拉换过角度，这次销子在第一声摆响前落进孔。

pairs.english: Tavi immediately recontacted with both hands and cancelled, without waiting for the second click, much less trying to lengthen that time.

pairs.hanzi: 卸载检查，铁片正常，销子的留置头将东西扣住，剩下的稳固是木头和铁本来就在做的事。

pairs.english: His eyes were a little tired, but his hands were not numb. Instructor Vey had them clear the table; that was enough for today.

pairs.english: “The boxes are drying today,” she said. “And I also need to learn to make other people wait for me.”
pairs.hanzi: “盒子今天在晾。”她说，“而且我也要学会让别人等我一下。”

pairs.target: bàngwǎn , tā ná zhe jīntiān de biǎo qù zhǎo yīwén . yīwén méi zài sùshè , zhuōshàng dǎofàng zhe nà zhāng qiǎn pén de chāo tú , xiàmiàn yǐjīng xiě hǎo láilì .
pairs.english: At dusk he went to find Iven with today’s sheet. Iven was not in the dormitory, but his copy of the shallow basin drawing lay on the table, its provenance already written below.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，他拿着今天的表去找伊文。伊文没在宿舍，桌上倒放着那张浅盆的抄图，下面已经写好来历。

pairs.target: dé mǎ zuòzài chuāng biān gěi yìshuāng hòu wà fèng míngzì , zì xiǎo dé xiàng yíliè wāi mǎyǐ .
pairs.english: Dema sat by the window sewing her name into thick socks, the tiny letters like a crooked line of ants.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛坐在窗边给一双厚袜缝名字，字小得像一列歪蚂蚁。

pairs.target: " pàrén tōu ? " tǎ wéi wèn . " pà xǐwán zhǎobùzhe . shíèrtiān búgòu wǒ chóngxīn rèn yíbiàn zìjǐ de jiǎo . "
pairs.english: “Afraid they will be stolen?” Tavi asked. “Afraid I will lose them in the wash. Twelve days is not enough to learn my own feet all over again.”
pairs.hanzi:
“怕人偷？”塔维问。
“怕洗完找不着。十二天不够我重新认一遍自己的脚。”

pairs.english: He sat down to thread her needle. The eye was small; instead of staring hard, he moved to brighter light before threading it.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐下替她穿线。针眼很小，他没有硬盯，换到灯亮些的地方才穿进去。

pairs.target: dé mǎ jiēguò zhēn , wèn jīntiān liàn dé zěnmeyàng . tā bǎ pèngdào dēngguāng , hǎntíng de shì jiǎng le , tā tīng wán xiào , ná wàzi zhǐzhǐ zìjǐ de yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: Dema took the needle and asked how practice had gone. He told her about the glare and the stop call; she laughed and pointed at her own eyes with the sock.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛接过针，问今天练得怎么样。他把碰到灯光、喊停的事讲了，她听完笑，拿袜子指指自己的眼睛。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi shuō mǎshàng jiù huì hǎo le . tā jiāng nà zhāng biǎo jiá zài zhuōbiān , kàn tā yìzhēn yizhēn , bǎ míngzì fèng dào wà kǒulǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi did not say it would get better at once. He clipped the sheet to the table’s edge and watched her stitch her name inside the sock cuff, one stitch at a time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没说马上就会好了。他将那张表夹在桌边，看她一针一针，把名字缝到袜口里。
